summary: Rabbi Harari examines the Gemara in Masekhet Bava Batra regarding communal taxes and the exemption of Talmidei Hakhamim. He discusses the concept of Kavod Talmidei Hakhamim through the lens of Rambam and analyzes the story of Rabbi and Rabbi Yonatan ben Amram to explore the balance between communal support and the personal responsibility of scholars.
questions: Are Talmidei Hakhamim exempt from paying communal taxes?
Is it the community's responsibility to support Talmidei Hakhamim?
How should we understand the story of Rabbi Yonatan ben Amram?
Does the exemption from taxes apply to all scholars or only those who study full-time?
